title: Kissed Crisp Mexican Corn Elote
description: A funky, crisp, and cozy Mexican dish featuring fines herbes and lacquer glaze, this recipe is a nut-free friendly version of the traditional Yucatecan elote.

ingredients.name: fines herbes
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh herbs like parsley, dill, and chives

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the corn on the cob for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2 minutes, until lightly charred.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, fines herbes, cotija cheese, lime juice, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Once the corn is cool enough to handle, brush the lacquer glaze or olive oil onto each ear.
Roll the grilled corn in the mayonnaise mixture to coat, making sure to get some of the cheese and herbs onto each ear.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fines herbes and cotija cheese if desired.
Let each guest squeeze a sliver of lime juice onto their elote before eating.
Consider serving with warm tortillas or crunchy tortilla chips on the side.
